title: Lensed Coast: light passing through a quiet control layer
decision: Separate a richly lit background from sparse, legible controls; reserve refraction for boundaries and keep critical text on a predictable surface.
cost: Transparency makes contrast scene-dependent; an opaque resting surface must remain available.
check: Inspect labels over the brightest and darkest backgrounds, including the opaque fallback.

system.layout: One main pane with grouped settings, a persistent current value, and a bottom-reachable primary action on narrow screens.

motion.reduced: Change the selected state immediately and freeze ambient refraction.

system.avoid: Do not refract text, stack nested blur panels, or imply the web shader is Apple's native material.

title: Orbital Instrument: a large subject with precise annotations
decision: Let the object occupy the visual center, use narrow annotation rails, and place controls where they do not cover the identifying silhouette.
cost: Dense instrument labels can falsely imply measured data; mark decorative readouts as illustrative.
check: Hide all annotations and verify the subject remains recognizable; then restore real controls and test touch reachability.

system.layout: Full-width scene, short top title, side annotation rail; put annotations below the scene rather than shrinking them on phones.

motion.reduced: Keep a deliberate camera pose; use direct selection feedback.

system.avoid: Do not turn every label into a blinking HUD or use bloom to hide missing geometry.

title: Workshop Ledger: dense work with explicit next actions
decision: Lead with the work queue and selected item, use aligned numeric columns, and let status explain which action is available.
cost: High density saves scanning distance only while labels, focus and row actions remain distinct.
check: Complete a task using keyboard, handle an empty queue, and distinguish stale data from zero.

system.layout: Navigation, filter row, worklist and selected detail. At small widths show one pane while preserving selection and the return route.

motion.reduced: Update rows in place and keep focus anchored to the affected item.

system.avoid: Do not replace actionable work with decorative KPI cards or invent operational figures.

title: Archive Paper: a publication with space to read
decision: Contrast an expressive headline with a steady reading column, give captions a separate role, and treat whitespace as a change in pace.
cost: Large display type needs editorially selected line breaks that still survive translation and text scaling.
check: Read the longest article with fonts unavailable and at a narrow width; headings must remain meaningful without the artwork.

system.layout: Opening image and title, a constrained reading column, captions attached to media and related stories after the conclusion.

motion.reduced: Open reading content without travel; never delay text visibility.

system.avoid: Do not justify every paragraph, rasterize article text or decorate each section as a separate card.

title: Material Room: a product explained through construction
decision: Use an uncluttered object view, measured material contrast and a compact configuration column with an honest selection summary.
cost: An attractive render cannot establish dimensions, stock, delivery or price; obtain those facts from the product source.
check: Select every finish and confirm the image, name and review state agree at both wide and narrow sizes.

system.layout: Object and options in two columns; move options below a stable-height preview on phones and retain the selected finish.

motion.reduced: Swap materials directly without rotating the object.

system.avoid: Do not fake a checkout, hide variant costs or turn material selection into an unlabeled color-only control.

title: Night Signal: controlled energy in a dark space
decision: Use one luminous moving subject against a quiet dark field, and keep navigation and playback controls on an unchanging plane.
cost: Bright high-speed repetition can overwhelm the content; intensity and pause need visible controls.
check: Test silence, a strong transient, manual pause and reduced motion without losing the subject or controls.

system.layout: Large visual stage with one short title and stable controls; details follow in ordinary document flow.

motion.reduced: Use a static lit composition and direct playback status; remove repeated zoom and travel.

system.avoid: Do not map raw audio bins to camera shake or make navigation depend on a moving target.

title: Civic Clear: a service that makes the next step legible
decision: Build around eligibility, required information, the current step and a recoverable confirmation; use color as reinforcement rather than instruction.
cost: A calm presentation must not soften important constraints, errors, fees or irreversible consequences.
check: Finish the actual form using keyboard, repair an error and return without losing entered information.

system.layout: Task heading, requirements, a single primary form column, adjacent explanations and an explicit review step when needed.

motion.reduced: Preserve focus and show feedback directly.

system.avoid: Do not hide labels in placeholders, invent trust badges, or disable submission without explaining the missing requirement.

title: Field Atlas: a place understood through layers
decision: Pair terrain-like structure with clear place labels, scale context and a readable detail panel; use texture to suggest place without obscuring information.
cost: A procedural landscape is not a navigational map and must not imply geographical accuracy.
check: Make labels and selection understandable with motion disabled and the decorative terrain hidden.

system.layout: Place index beside a visual field and selected detail; put detail after the selected place on narrow screens.

motion.reduced: Retain a static contour composition and immediate place selection.

system.avoid: Do not infer coordinates, trail safety or live weather from a decorative procedural field.
